description: Prices one standalone picture from a text prompt and optional owned uploads, using the same pricing as the Brix36 create box. Returns the exact credits and price with draftId and quoteId. Nothing is generated or charged.

artistId.description: Optional Artist DNA ID when the picture stars an existing artist.

attachmentIds.description: Optional owned uploaded pictures that guide the result.

draftId.description: Stable draft ID for this picture. Optional when pricing; the price returns one. Reusing it with changed details reprices the same draft.

enhancePrompt.description: Whether to apply deterministic Brix36 picture prompt enhancing (default true). Set false to send your exact prompt words unchanged.

mode.description: Optional exact catalogue profile identifier, equivalent to profileKey.

modelKey.description: Optional picture model identifier or display name when a specific engine is requested.

numImages.description: Number of pictures, within the selected model limits.

profileKey.description: Optional picture profile or quality tier when requested.

prompt.description: What the picture should show, in the customer's words.

promptMode.description: Prompt mode: 'enhanced' (default) applies deterministic picture craft; 'exact' sends your prompt words unchanged.

referenceFiles.description: Optional attached reference media. Up to 30 files and URLs combined. Ordered after any attachmentIds and before any referenceImageUrls; every file is required and any failed file stops quoting without charging.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download link for an attached reference file.

file_id.description: Host file identifier for an attached reference file.

mime_type.description: Declared supported image, video or audio MIME type.

referenceImageUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS reference media links. Up to 30 files and URLs combined. Ordered after any attachmentIds and referenceFiles; every link is required and any failed link stops quoting without charging.

items.description: Public HTTPS link to a supported image, video or audio file.

resolution.description: Optional exact resolution offered by the selected model profile.

name: studio_image_quote
title: Price a picture
